title: Reduced-Order Layered MFP Soil-Water Solver Feasibility

base.reason: Use the qualified common solver contract and explicit process hydraulic view without inheriting the reopened F-SI16 prescribed-bottom-head work or later experimental solver work.

source_basis.wofost_primary_technical_reference: Rappoldt et al. 2012, Extension of the WOFOST soil water submodel; Comparison with SWAP and technical documentation
source_basis.license_caution: Do not directly copy Appendix C WATFDGW source into SWAP5 without separate license/provenance clearance; prefer clean reimplementation from documented equations and regression behavior.

scope.purpose: Determine whether a WOFOST-lineage layered matric-flux-potential soil-water solver can become an explicitly selected alternative SWAP5 soil-water solver for a qualified physical envelope.

decision_reason: Source reconstruction and SWAP5 architectural fit are sufficient to justify an isolated prototype, while physical equivalence, groundwater behavior, generic-time limiter reformulation, response tangents and production qualification envelope remain empirical questions for comparison against FullRichards.

important_holds.prescribed_bottom_head_common_route: DEPENDENCY_NOT_STABLE; F-SI16 currently reopened after qbot oracle mismatch
